category.name: Phrasal Verbs
category.description: Verba gabungan yang paling sering dipakai penutur asli.

words.definition: To stop trying to do something.
words.example: Don't give up after one mistake.

words.definition: To take care of someone or something.
words.example: She looks after her younger brother.

words.definition: To understand or solve something.
words.example: I finally figured out the problem.

words.definition: To have no more of something.
words.example: We ran out of coffee this morning.

words.definition: To refuse an offer or request.
words.example: He turned down the job offer.

words.definition: To raise a child, or to mention a topic.
words.example: She brought up an important question.

words.definition: To have a good relationship with someone.
words.example: I get along well with my teammates.
words.example_id: Saya akur dengan rekan satu tim.

words.definition: To delay something to a later time.
words.example: They put off the meeting until Friday.

words.definition: To find something by chance.
words.example: I came across an old photo yesterday.
words.example_id: Saya menemukan foto lama kemarin secara tidak sengaja.

words.definition: When a plane leaves the ground, or to remove clothing.
words.example: The plane takes off at seven.

words.definition: To stop working suddenly.
words.example: My motorbike broke down on the way.

words.definition: To cancel something.
words.example: They called off the match because of rain.

words.definition: To continue doing something.
words.example: Carry on with your work.

words.definition: To register at a hotel or airport.
words.example: We checked in at two o'clock.

words.definition: To think of an idea or plan.
words.example: She came up with a clever solution.

words.definition: To reduce the amount of something.
words.example: I want to cut down on sugar.

words.definition: To handle a problem or situation.
words.example: She dealt with the complaint calmly.
words.example_id: Dia menangani keluhan itu dengan tenang.

words.definition: To take someone somewhere, or to fall asleep.
words.example: Can you drop me off at the station?

words.definition: To write information in a form.
words.example: Fill in your name and address.

words.definition: To discover information.
words.example: I found out the truth later.

words.definition: To recover from an illness or bad experience.
words.example: It took a week to get over the flu.
words.example_id: Butuh seminggu untuk pulih dari flu.

words.definition: To finally agree after refusing.
words.example: He gave in and apologised.

words.definition: To examine or review something carefully.
words.example: Let's go over the plan once more.
words.example_id: Mari tinjau ulang rencananya sekali lagi.

words.definition: To wait for a short time.
words.example: Hold on, I'll check the schedule.

words.definition: To feel happy about something in the future.
words.example: I look forward to meeting you.

words.definition: To search for information in a book or online.
words.example: Look up the word in the dictionary.

words.definition: To collect someone or something.
words.example: I'll pick you up at eight.

words.definition: To draw attention to something.
words.example: She pointed out a mistake in the report.
words.example_id: Dia menunjukkan kesalahan dalam laporan itu.

words.definition: To arrange or start something.
words.example: They set up a new company last year.
words.example_id: Mereka mendirikan perusahaan baru tahun lalu.

words.definition: To arrive at a place, often unexpectedly.
words.example: He showed up an hour late.

words.definition: To support someone, or to copy data safely.
words.example: Back up your files every week.

words.definition: To explode or suddenly become angry.
words.example: He blew up when he saw the bill.
words.example_id: Dia marah besar saat melihat tagihannya.

words.definition: To return something, or make you remember.
words.example: This song brings back memories.

words.definition: To phone someone again.
words.example: I'll call you back in five minutes.
words.example_id: Saya akan meneleponmu balik lima menit lagi.

words.definition: To reach the same level, or share recent news.
words.example: Let's catch up over coffee.

words.definition: To depend on someone.
words.example: You can count on me.

words.definition: To wear formal or special clothes.
words.example: We dressed up for the dinner.
words.example_id: Kami berdandan untuk makan malam itu.

words.definition: To finally be in a situation you did not plan.
words.example: We ended up walking home.

words.definition: To break into pieces or stop working well.
words.example: The old chair finally fell apart.

words.definition: To move backwards away from something.
words.example: He backed away from the dog.

words.definition: To end a relationship.
words.example: They broke up last month.

words.definition: To reduce something or make it fall.
words.example: The sale brought prices down.

words.definition: To ask someone to speak, or to visit.
words.example: The teacher called on me first.
words.example_id: Guru meminta saya bicara lebih dulu.

words.definition: To become less angry or worried.
words.example: Take a breath and calm down.

words.definition: To perform a plan or task.
words.example: They carried out the survey.

words.definition: To become popular, or to understand.
words.example: The trend caught on quickly.

words.definition: To look at something, or to leave a hotel.
words.example: Check out this new cafe.

words.definition: To become happier.
words.example: Cheer up, the exam is over.

words.definition: To stop a connection or supply.
words.example: The call was cut off.

words.definition: To become weaker or quieter.
words.example: The rain died down at dusk.

words.definition: To visit briefly.
words.example: Drop by whenever you like.

words.definition: To eat at a restaurant.
words.example: We eat out once a week.
words.example_id: Kami makan di luar sekali sepekan.

words.definition: To begin sleeping.
words.example: I fell asleep on the sofa.

words.definition: To rise from bed or a chair.
words.example: I get up at six every day.
words.example_id: Saya bangun pukul enam setiap hari.

words.definition: To return something to its owner.
words.example: Please give back my book.

words.definition: To continue.
words.example: The meeting went on for hours.

words.definition: To become an adult.
words.example: She grew up in Bandung.

words.definition: To stop someone or something from moving.
words.example: Don't hold back your ideas.

words.definition: To move faster.
words.example: Hurry up, the bus is leaving.

words.definition: To stay at the same pace or standard.
words.example: She struggled to keep up with the class.

words.definition: To be careful of danger.
words.example: Look out, there is a car!

words.definition: To die (polite).
words.example: His grandfather passed away last year.

words.definition: To prepare the body for exercise.
words.example: Warm up before you run.

words.definition: To investigate something.
words.example: We will look into the complaint.

words.definition: To examine quickly.
words.example: Please look over my report.

words.definition: To invent a story, or to become friends again.
words.example: They made up after the argument.

words.definition: To confuse two things.
words.example: I mixed up the two names.

words.definition: To start something new after an event.
words.example: It is time to move on.

words.definition: To return money that you borrowed.
words.example: I will pay you back tomorrow.

words.definition: To put something in its place.
words.example: Put away your books, please.

words.definition: To start a journey, or to cause something.
words.example: We set off before sunrise.
